title: diasperus lacteus
intro: Diasperus lacteus, commonly known as Milk Thistle, is a flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family. It is known for its health benefits, which include liver protection, antioxidant properties, and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Diasperus lacteus include treating liver diseases, such as cirrhosis and hepatitis, as well as supporting the treatment of jaundice, gallstones, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Diasperus lacteus include silymarin, a flavonoid complex that is responsible for its medicinal properties.
